name: Doran Teca
personality: quietly observant more than he admits
daily_routine: occasional visits to plaza for trade/barter

goals.public_goal: Maintain stable food production and prevent famine while keeping terrace systems functioning year-round
goals.hidden_goal: Expand arable land without provoking political or religious conflict
goals.deep_goal: Ensure his family is never blamed if crops fail again

beliefs: If people eat, they stop arguing (mostly)
Old rituals are fine if they don’t interfere with farming
The mountain water system is more important than any legend
Drought is always closer than people think
